== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Tallon Roll]]. One column per published text state in date order (printed card, Decipher's errata, each Players Committee errata image); the stamp row describes the mark on each image. Revised, Japanese, foil and Virtual printings stay in Versions. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reprints: [[Tallon Roll (Unlimited)]] (1996) prints the words of the Original column; only notation differs, so it has no column of its own.

Reflections Gold: [[Tallon Roll (Reflections Gold)]] is an unpublished playtest text of the cancelled [[Reflections Gold]] set (Decipher, 2001); it has its own column, labelled as such. Its highlights mark words that differ from the published column before it. The next published column is still compared with that published column, not with the playtest.
